senses.gloss: f. (שָׁפַל, cmp. פָּשַׁל) a wicker basket carried on a pole over the shoulder.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 9</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִשְׁפָּלוֹת</he>.
Shebi. III, 2 מ׳ של לתך לתך baskets (of foliage for dung) of a lethekh each.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מוסיפין על המ׳ וכ׳</he> you may add to the number of baskets (to be put on the dunghills) &c. Y. ib. 34ᶜ top <he>לא יפרוק את המ׳</he> he (the Israelite) must not unload the baskets.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite>; a. fr.
